title: Canonical maps of Artinian square-zero parameter algebras
statement: Let $R$ be a commutative Noetherian ring and $k$ a field of finite type over $R$. Use the marked Artinian test category $\mathcal C_{R,k}$ and its square-zero objects $k[V]$ from [def-sfb-artin-deformation-test-category]. For finite-dimensional $k$-vector spaces $V,W$ and a $k$-linear map $f:V\to W$, define the canonical morphism $k[f]:k[V]\to k[W]$ in $\mathcal C_{R,k}$ by $(a,v)\mapsto(a,f(v))$. Its underlying algebra map is the trivial-square-zero-extension map of [def-sc-trivial-square-zero-extension], restricted to $R$ and preserving the specified residue markings.
